room.occlusion_deployables: What interior occlusion hides inside a room: 0 = nothing (building blocks only), 1 = static entities (boxes, workbenches, beds), 2 = also IO entities (wires and pipes can be dragged to an entity that is not on your client) (1)

room.occlusion_range: How far from a player interior occlusion looks for rooms to hide things in, in metres. Must comfortably exceed network range; rooms beyond it fail open. (250)
rustnav.addtilebudgetms: Main-thread time budget per frame (ms) for adding built navmesh tiles to their navmesh. A base rebuild lands dozens of results in one frame and the rest waits for the next one. 0 or less adds every result that is ready, which is what shipped before the budget existed (2)
rustnav.bakestatsenabled: Collect navmesh bake statistics (rustnav.bakestats to read them). Defaults on in the editor, off on servers; flip on live to diagnose bake issues, then reset with rustnav.bakestats true (False)
rustnav.collectbudgetms: Main-thread time budget per frame (ms) for navmesh tile geometry collection. The full-map bake wall clock is roughly tiles / (budget-worth of tiles per frame) / fps, so raise this while baking to trade frame time for bake speed (1)
rustnav.detailsampledistmult: Detail mesh sample distance as a multiple of cellSize (Recast default 6). Larger = cheaper detail mesh, coarser surface height. Applies to tiles built after the change (12)
rustnav.detailsamplemaxerrormult: Detail mesh max sample error as a multiple of cellHeight (Recast default 1). Larger = cheaper detail mesh, more height error. Applies to tiles built after the change (1)
rustnav.doorreassertspertick: How many doors re-assert their gate state per navmesh drain tick. A rebuilt tile bakes its apertures shut, so every open or npc-openable door over the rebuilt area has to write its state again, and a megabase queues hundreds of them at once. 0 or less applies the whole queue in one frame, which is what shipped before the budget existed (24)
rustnav.drawkbps: Max KB per second of navmesh tiles streamed to each rustnav.draw viewer (512)
rustnav.legacybuild: A/B kill switch: build navmesh tiles with the stock pre optimization algorithms (clip rasterizer, full ledge and region rescans, unfused filters). Combine with detailsampledistmult 6 to approximate the old build end to end. Applies to tiles built after the change (False)
rustnav.maxshoredistance: Metres of open water past which default navmesh tiles are dropped instead of baked. A tile only drops when every point in it is that far from land, so shores keep their navmesh and so do rivers and lakes, which are never that wide. Independent navmeshes (oilrigs, tropical islands, ghost ships) are never touched. 0 or less bakes the open sea like before. Applies to tiles queued after the change (100)
rustnav.numthreads: Navmesh tile builder worker thread count. Applied when the builder is (re)created - at boot, or via rustnav.setnumthreads at runtime. ~half the cores is the sweet spot for full-map bakes (4)
rustnav.savecompression: LZ4-compress navmesh saves (smaller .navmesh files, no extra save time) (True)
rustnav.savedelta: Append only the tiles that changed to the navmesh file instead of rewriting all of it. The first save after a boot or a rebuild is always a full write, and a full write also happens once the appended part grows past rustnav.savedeltabudget (True)
rustnav.savedeltabudget: How large the appended part of the navmesh file may grow, as a fraction of the full file, before the next save rewrites the whole thing. A save whose changed tiles are a larger share of the mesh than this rewrites it too. Bounds both file growth and boot load time. 0 or less removes the bound, to stop appending altogether use rustnav.savedelta false (0.5)
rustnav.savethreads: Worker threads for navmesh save/load compression. 0 = auto (0)
rustnav.savewarnms: Log the navmesh save completion line as a warning past this many milliseconds. 0 or less never warns (1000)
satellite.cooldown_hours_max: Maximum cooldown between satellite events, in game hours (18)
satellite.cooldown_hours_min: Minimum cooldown between satellite events, in game hours (not real minutes) — converted to real time via the map's day length, same as the airdrop event scheduler. (18)
satellite.crashing_fx_at_distance: Run the crashing FX pass (FX Pass 3) through the whole phase-2 descent, including the distance-projected stretch, instead of waiting until the satellite enters real draw distance. The projected-mode fixup still applies — its particles simulate in local space and scale with the model; its trails stay gated until real rendering. (True)
satellite.crate_fire_duration: Seconds the crash loot crates burn and stay unlootable after impact. All crates unlock together when this expires. (300)
satellite.debug: Log crash-target search diagnostics (samples, blockers, reasons) (False)
satellite.default_crash_radius: Starting impact radius before thruster adjustments, in meters (300)
satellite.descent_angle: Angle (degrees from vertical) the satellite descends at. Higher = more horizontal streak across the sky. Clamped to 45 so it always reaches the ground within 45 degrees of straight down. Only used when flyover_altitude is 0 — the flyover path has its own geometry. (45)
satellite.descent_seconds: Descent duration in seconds (0 = use day length fraction; nonzero values are clamped to a minimum of final_descent_seconds so the phase-2 window always fits inside the descent) (600)
satellite.final_descent_seconds: Seconds before the scheduled crash that the satellite begins its phase-2 physics descent. Phase 1 slides in to the phase-2 start point up until then, then the satellite drops at a speed timed to hit the ground exactly on schedule. The start point is placed at the satellite's finalDescentSpeed times this window, so lengthening it starts the descent higher rather than slowing the fall. (300)
satellite.final_descent_speed: Speed (m/s) of the phase-2 physics descent (0 = use the satellite prefab's finalDescentSpeed). Together with final_descent_seconds this sets where phase 2 starts — speed times seconds back up the descent line — so e.g. 180s at 80 m/s starts the drop 14.4km out. (0)
satellite.flyover_altitude: Altitude (m above the crash target) of the phase-2 flyover cruise. The satellite enters near-horizontally at this height, streaks across the sky, then bends into a dive onto the target from flyover_dive_distance out. 0 = disable the flyover and use the legacy straight-line descent at descent_angle. (2500)
satellite.flyover_dive_distance: Horizontal distance (m) from the crash target at which the flyover bends into its terminal dive. Smaller = a longer level cruise with a steeper final plunge. (1500)
satellite.free_fuel: If true, firing satellite thrusters does not consume fuel (False)
satellite.free_power: If true, powering up the satellite computer does not require any items (False)
satellite.fuel_large_max: Maximum fuel rolled for large satellites (3000-5000kg) (16)
satellite.fuel_large_min: Minimum fuel rolled for large satellites (3000-5000kg) (10)
satellite.fuel_max: Hard maximum on generated fuel, applied after the per-size roll regardless of size (36)
satellite.fuel_medium_max: Maximum fuel rolled for medium satellites (1500-3000kg) (26)
satellite.fuel_medium_min: Minimum fuel rolled for medium satellites (1500-3000kg) (16)
satellite.fuel_min: Hard minimum on generated fuel, applied after the per-size roll regardless of size (8)
satellite.fuel_small_max: Maximum fuel rolled for small satellites (500-1500kg) (36)
satellite.fuel_small_min: Minimum fuel rolled for small satellites (500-1500kg) (24)
satellite.initial_offset_attempts: How many times to re-roll the initial random map position, re-checking the full crash-site acceptance each time, until a valid starting target is found. Guarantees the control phase never starts on an unusable spot. (8)
satellite.kill_radius: Radius (m) around the impact point cleared on crash — players killed, construction/deployables/vehicles destroyed, vegetation removed (10)
satellite.lateral_distance: Lateral offset multiplier per thruster fire (meters) (200)
satellite.nudge_distance_max: Maximum random aim drift (meters) applied when tightening the impact radius (150)
satellite.nudge_distance_min: Minimum random aim drift (meters) applied when tightening the impact radius, at a fully random angle so it can't be cancelled out exactly by the cardinal-direction lateral thrusters (100)
satellite.obstruction_tc_reorder: Crash targeting: use the tool-cupboard grid to test likely-occupied samples last, so a clear spot is usually found with fewer physics checks. The physics check stays authoritative. (True)
satellite.phase1_extra_distance: Extra distance (m) further out, along the descent line, that phase 1 starts. The satellite slides steadily from there in to the orbit point over phase 1, then phase 2 continues along the same line. (30000)
satellite.phase1_grow_scale: Multiplier the orbiting satellite's glow billboard grows to by the end of phase 1 (starts at 1x). Purely a visual telegraph; replicated because the grow runs client-side. (4)
satellite.require_powerplant: If true, the satellite control computer can only be powered up while the power plant is active (powergrid stage 1+). Ignored when the powergrid system itself is disabled. (True)
satellite.reuse_last_crash_spot: Crash targeting: before scanning, re-test the previously found crash spot. Small thruster nudges usually leave it valid, returning in a single check. (True)
satellite.shrink_expand_radius: Impact radius change per thruster fire (meters) (25)
satellite.site_check_physical_geometry: Also raycast the crash-site footprint against real collision geometry, rejecting spots with rocks or scenery the heightmap can't see (True)
satellite.site_clearance_radius: Clearance (m) the crash-site search demands around a candidate — rejected if any player building, prevent-building volume or safezone is within this range. Kept separate from kill_radius so targeting standoff can exceed what the impact destroys; 16 matches the building-privilege radius, so a valid site is never inside a base's TC influence. (16)
satellite.site_footprint_radius: Radius (m) around a candidate crash spot sampled for ground shape — roughly the crash remains footprint. Used both to reject unsuitable spots and to fit the spawned remains to the ground. (15)
satellite.site_max_slope: Max overall ground slope (degrees) across the crash footprint before a spot is rejected (25)
satellite.site_max_unevenness: Max terrain height deviation (m) from the crash footprint's best-fit plane before a spot is rejected as too uneven (cliff edges, crests, dips the remains meshes can't hide) (2)
satellite.sky_trail: Render the satellite's descent as a map-wide sky ribbon tracing the real flight path, visible from any distance at any draw distance setting. Rendered client-side from the entity's networked positions. (True)
satellite.sky_trail_age_fade: Fade each point of the sky ribbon out over its lifetime (sky_trail_seconds), like a TrailRenderer — the streak continuously dissolves behind the satellite instead of holding full brightness until its points expire. (True)
satellite.sky_trail_drain_seconds: Seconds the sky ribbon takes to drain away tail-first after the satellite crashes or is destroyed. The recorded point ages are compressed into this window, so the ribbon keeps shrinking exactly the way it does in flight, and the impact end of the streak is the last to go. (10)
satellite.sky_trail_max_length: Maximum length of the sky ribbon in meters of flight path — the tail is trimmed to keep the ribbon at or under this. 0 = no length cap, letting the sky_trail_seconds lifetime fade own the tail instead of a hard cut. (0)
satellite.sky_trail_noise: Meters of smooth random wobble baked into the sky ribbon as it's laid down, so the streak reads as turbulent rather than a perfect straight line. Keep it under the dish's size (~3m) or the trail visibly detaches from the model. 0 = perfectly straight. (1)
satellite.sky_trail_seconds: Seconds of flight path the sky ribbon spans — its TrailRenderer-style lifetime: with sky_trail_age_fade on, points dissolve to nothing as they reach this age. Capped by the ribbon's internal point budget at ~128s. (60)
satellite.sky_trail_width_degrees: On-screen thickness of the sky ribbon's head, in degrees of view angle — it holds the same apparent width whatever distance it's projected at, tapering to a point at the tail. (0.075)
satellite.targeting_budget_ms: Crash targeting: max milliseconds per frame spent scanning for a safe crash site. The scan resumes next frame when exceeded. (5)
satellite.targeting_coverage_factor: Crash targeting: candidate samples tested per clearance-footprint, i.e. per (targetingRadius/clearanceRadius)^2. The sample count scales with the targeting area, so a small circle runs far fewer checks than a large one. ~1.2 is bare geometric coverage (samples spaced ~one clearance apart); the default adds margin to catch tight gaps. Pushing it much higher mostly adds correlated, redundant checks. (3)
satellite.targeting_min_samples: Crash targeting: minimum candidate samples per search, regardless of how small the targeting circle is. Floors the area-scaled sample count so a small but cluttered area still gets a fair number of attempts. (8)
satellite.thruster_extra_steps: When a thruster move finds no valid crash site, how many extra steps to take in the same direction before giving up. Fuel cost is linear in the number of steps taken (a 3-step move costs 3 fuel), and a further step isn't attempted if the player can't afford it. (2)
satellite.thruster_module_count: Thruster modules salvaged from fully harvesting the crash remains (3)
satellite.thruster_module_min_condition: Minimum condition fraction of salvaged thruster modules, regardless of how much fuel the satellite burned before lock-in (0.2)
satellite.trail_alpha_scale: Multiplier on the alpha of the satellite trails' authored colour gradients, saturating at full opacity — the authored fades drop to near-transparent within the first quarter of the trail, so values above 1 keep progressively more of its length visible. Applied alongside trail_time_scale as the trails switch on. (1)
satellite.trail_time_scale: Multiplier on the authored lifetime of the satellite's trail renderers — a trail spans this many times the authored seconds of flight path, so it directly scales the visible streak length. Applied as the trails switch on (they sit out the projected far-distance stretch and only run once the satellite is drawn at its real position), so changes take effect at the next handover, not mid-trail. Replicated because trails render client-side. (1)
satellite.wreck_fire_duration: Seconds the main wreck stays too hot to harvest after impact (480)

sentry.scantimer: How quickly can a turret acquire a potential target. Less is faster, but perf taxing (1)

apartment.printitemtax: Print out a list of all items that apartments will tax
apartment.scheduleddeath: Test triggering the scheduled death in safezones
apartment.testapartmentsecuritydoor: Test triggering the apartment security door

app.info: Prints the Rust+ companion server ID, addresses and open backhauls from the backend

bradley.quickrespawn: (Generated) Forces an immediate Bradley APC respawn, bypassing the normal respawn delay; admin only
clan.addtoclan: Adds a player by SteamID64 to your current clan
clan.info: Prints info about a clan given its ID or a steamID of a player in that clan
clan.scoretest: Adds a generic score event to your clan

copypaste.printselection_sv: (Generated) Server-side handler that prints the names of all entities within the current selection bounds; used to preview what would be included in a copy operation
copypaste.undopaste_sv: (Generated) Undoes the most recent paste operation for the calling player by destroying all entities that were spawned in that paste; replies with 'History empty' if nothing to undo
creative.togglealwaysonall: (Generated) Sets the always-on state for all IAlwaysOn entities on the server (e.g. lights, switches); only works when alwaysOnEnabled is true and caller is in creative mode

data.export: (Generated) Exports a named terrain map layer (splatmap, heightmap, biomemap, topologymap, alphamap, watermap) to a .raw file in the persistent data path
ddraw.ddrawother: (Generated) Sends a ddraw.text debug draw command to a specific player by Steam ID or name; allows admins to display debug text overlays on another player screen

debug.applybuildingblockrandomisation: (Generated) Sets the visual variant index on the building block the calling player is looking at; useful for testing block randomisation visuals
debug.applypuzzleresettime: (Generated) Applies a debug reset time in seconds to all PuzzleReset objects in the scene, shortening their timers for rapid testing
debug.bench_io: Spawn lots of IO entities to lag the server
debug.breakheld_almost: Almost break the current held object
debug.breakitem: Break all the items in your inventory whose name match the passed string
debug.clearplayermodifiers: (Generated) Removes all active modifiers (buffs/debuffs) from the calling player; useful for resetting modifier state during testing
debug.cleartutorialforplayer: If a player ends up stuck on a tutorial for any reason this will clear the island and reset the player (will also kill player)
debug.completemission: (Generated) Completes all incomplete objectives in the calling player active mission, triggering the mission completion flow
debug.completetutorial: (Generated) Immediately completes the calling player tutorial by triggering the island completion callback; bypasses normal progression
debug.console_print_color: (Generated) Prints a message to the server console using the specified ConsoleColor index; useful for testing coloured console output
debug.console_spam: (Generated) Logs a configurable number of test messages of a given length; used to stress-test console/logging performance and measure output speed
debug.conveyorstrictmodereport: (Generated) Prints the world position of every industrial conveyor running in strict mode; helps locate conveyors that are blocking item flow
debug.deleteentitiesbyshortname: <shortname> (optional: <radius>) - Delete entities with the given short prefab name
debug.deleteentitybyid: Delete entities by id. Supports multiple arguments
debug.drink: (Generated) Adds a specified amount of hydration to the calling player at a configurable rate; useful for quickly testing thirst-related mechanics
debug.dropworlditems: (Generated) Drops a specified number of the given item short name as world entities from just in front of the calling player; useful for item physics testing
debug.eat: (Generated) Adds a specified amount of calories to the calling player at a configurable rate; useful for quickly testing hunger-related mechanics
debug.emptytankermodule: emptyTankerModule - Clears the contents of the tanker module(s) of the modular car you're looking at
debug.enable_player_movement: (Generated) Sends a client RPC to the target player enabling or disabling their movement controls; admin only; useful for testing freeze/lock mechanics
debug.fillmounts: fillmounts <radius> - Spawns and mounts a player on every mount point in radius
debug.filltankermodule: fillTankerModule <item> - Fills the tanker module(s) of the modular car you're looking at with the given liquid (e.g. water, water.salt, crude.oil)
debug.findgap: Find how large of a gap there is. <maxDistance> <stepsize> <maxSize> <layer>
debug.flushgroup: Takes you in and out of your current network group, causing you to delete and then download all entities in your PVS again
debug.foodspoilingdeducttimehours: Deducts the given number of hours from all spoilable food on the server
debug.foodspoilinginventoryhours: Applies the given number of hours to all food in the players inventory
debug.foodspoilingspoilall: Spoils all food on the server
debug.forcechickensspawnegg: (Generated) Forces all chickens within a given radius of the calling player to immediately spawn an egg; useful for testing egg drop and collection logic
debug.heal: To disable revival if player is downed, pass in --no-recover as the first argument.
debug.hurt: (Generated) Deals a specified amount of bullet damage to the calling player; optionally targets a named bone to test per-bone hit reactions
debug.print_topologies: Prints out the topologies at your position
debug.printgrouplayer: (Generated) Prints the network visibility layer (overworld, tunnel, underwater, etc.) at the calling player position; helps debug layer-based network group assignment
debug.printgroups: (Generated) Logs all server entity network group IDs and prefab names to the console; useful for debugging network visibility and group assignment
debug.printmonumentblocker: Prints the health and decay state of the monument blocker closest to you. Optional argument: search range in metres (default 100)
debug.printqueues: (Generated) Prints a table of all ObjectWorkQueue instances showing name, total items processed, current queue length, and cumulative execution time
debug.puzzlereset: Reset all puzzles. Optionally provide a number to only reset puzzles within a radius.
debug.puzzleresetinfo: (Generated) Prints detailed debug info about the PuzzleReset the calling player is currently inside, including timer state and dependency status
debug.refillvitals: Refills the vital of a target player. eg. debug.refillsvital jim - leave blank to target yourself, can take multiple players at once. Will revive players if they are injured. To disable this, pass in --no-recover as the first argument.

debug.refrigeratedinventoryhours: Adds the given number of refrigerated hours to all food in the players inventory, so things like milk skimming can be tested without waiting
debug.removeoverlappingstaticspawnpoints: (Generated) Scans all static respawn areas and kills any whose centre is within 1 metre of another, eliminating duplicate spawn points
debug.renderinfo: (Generated) Generates and logs a render info report showing draw calls, batch counts, triangle counts, and shadow caster counts for the current frame
debug.resetsleepingbagtimers: (Generated) Resets all sleeping bag respawn cooldown timers for the calling player, allowing immediate re-use of all their bags
debug.respawnvinetreesinradius: (Generated) Respawns vine trees from their stumps within a given radius of the calling player; reports how many were respawned versus blocked by players
debug.setdamage: (Generated) Deals enough bullet damage to bring the calling player or a named target to the specified health value
debug.setfood: (Generated) Sets the calling player or a named target player calorie level to the specified value directly
debug.sethealth: (Generated) Sets the calling player or a named target player health to the specified value; useful for testing low-health or death scenarios
debug.setmaxhealth: (Generated) Overrides the maximum health of the calling player or a named target; pass 0 to reset to the default value
debug.setradiation: (Generated) Sets the calling player or a named target player radiation level to the specified value directly
debug.setthrowable: 0 = can't throw, 1 = can throw & melee, 2 = only throwable
debug.setunloadablecarfillpercent: (Generated) Sets the ore fill percentage on all unloadable train cars within 3 metres of the calling player; updates both inventory amounts and visual ore level
debug.setwater: (Generated) Sets the calling player or a named target player hydration level to the specified value directly
debug.spawn_all_deployables: Spawns one of every deployable in a grid
debug.spawnovenstresstest: (Generated) Spawns a 100x10 grid of lit furnaces loaded with wood and metal ore near the calling player; used to stress-test the oven cooking system
debug.spawnparachutetester: (Generated) Spawns a clone of the calling player at a configurable height with a parachute deployed and their belt and wear inventories copied
debug.stall: (Generated) Stalls the main thread for the given duration in seconds (clamped 0-1); admin-only; used to test timeout handling and watchdog systems
debug.test_custom_vitals: (Generated) Sends a configurable number of test custom vital entries to the calling player client for a given duration; used to verify custom vitals UI rendering
debug.testerror: Logs a test error and exception for testing error display.
debug.testtutorialcinematic: (Generated) Triggers the tutorial island ending cinematic for the calling player; spawns a kayak at the designated mount point and mounts the player to it
debug.tutorialstatus: (Generated) Prints a table of all active tutorial islands showing index, network group ID, assigned player name, duration, and connection state
debug.vineswinginghighlight: (Generated) Sends a highlight RPC to every VineMountable on the server targeting the calling player; used for visually debugging vine placement
debug.vineswingingreport: (Generated) Prints a summary table of all VineSwingingTree and VineMountable entities on the server, including average destination count per mountable
decay.addfakeauthhistory: addfakeauthhistory <count>, adds fake deauthed players to the auth history of the tool cupboard you are standing in, for testing group upkeep tiers
decay.clearauthhistory: Clears the deauthed player history on the tool cupboard you are standing in, dropping its group upkeep back to the number of authed players
decay.drawnearbybuildings: drawnearbybuildings <duration> <radius>, shows building ID of entities
decay.forcedecaytick: Call the decay tick on every single entity on the server (for testing decay works)
deepsea.close: Initiates the deep sea closing sequence
deepsea.createdeepsea: Creates the deep sea manager entity on the server
deepsea.enterdeepsea: Teleports the player (or their mounted vehicle) into the deep sea
deepsea.leavedeepsea: Teleports the player (or their mounted vehicle) back to the main island from the deep sea.
deepsea.open: Initiates the deep sea opening sequence
deepsea.printboatteleports: Prints what players on the player's boat will be teleported to the deep sea
deepsea.printentitycount: Prints a breakdown of all entities currently in the deep sea
deepsea.printloot: Prints a breakdown of all loot containers, trees, and ore nodes currently in the deep sea
deepsea.printtimetowipe: Prints the current time remaining until the deep sea wipes
deepsea.settimetonextopening: Sets the time in seconds until the deep sea re-opens after a wipe
deepsea.settimetowipe: Sets the time in seconds until the deep sea wipe triggers
deepsea.spawnfloatingcityhere: Spawns a random floating city prefab at the player position
deepsea.spawnghostshiphere: Spawns a random ghost ship prefab at the player position
deepsea.spawnislandhere: Spawns a random deep sea island prefab at the player position
deepsea.spawnrhibgrouphere: Spawns a RHIB patrol boat group at the player position
deepsea.status: Prints the current deep sea status

demo.record: (Generated) Starts recording a server-side demo for the specified player by name or Steam ID to a timestamped file; the player must be connected
demo.stop: (Generated) Stops the active server-side demo recording for the specified player and finalises the demo file
entity.countby: Count all entities created by provided users (separate users by space)
entity.debug_toggle: (Generated) Toggles the debug info overlay for an entity by net ID, showing position, velocity, health, and network state in the world
entity.deletebytextblock: Destroy all entities created by users in the provided text block (can use with copied results from ent auth)
entity.find_entity: (Generated) Lists all networked entities whose prefab path contains the given filter string in a formatted table; admin-only on client
entity.find_group: (Generated) Lists all networked entities belonging to the given network group ID in a formatted table; admin-only on client
entity.find_id: (Generated) Lists the networked entity with the given network entity ID in a formatted table; admin-only on client
entity.find_parent: (Generated) Lists all networked entities that have the given network entity ID as their parent in a formatted table; admin-only on client
entity.find_radius: (Generated) Lists all networked entities within the given radius in metres of the calling player in a formatted table; admin-only on client
entity.find_self: (Generated) Lists all networked entities owned by the calling player (matched by network ID) in a formatted table; admin-only on client
entity.find_status: (Generated) Lists all networked entities whose status string contains the given filter text in a formatted table; admin-only on client
entity.nudge: (Generated) Applies a small positional nudge to an entity by net ID, useful for unsticking entities that are clipping into geometry
entity.set_battery_charge: (Generated) Sets the charge level of an electric battery entity by net ID to the given percentage (0-100)
entity.spawnlootfrom: (Generated) Spawns a copy of the loot table from one container prefab into the world at the calling player position
entity.spawnplants: Spawn every stage of every plant inside it's own planter, with an optional filter
entity.spawn: (Generated) Spawns a server entity by prefab name at a given world position and direction; returns the spawned entity net ID
entity.spawngrid: (Generated) Spawns a grid of server entities by prefab name centred at a position; useful for stress-testing entity counts
entity.spawnitem: (Generated) Spawns a dropped item entity server-side by item short name at a given world position
entity.spawnvendor: (Generated) Spawns a complete NPC vendor by vendor name and the stock it should sell - both the shopkeeper NPC and the invisible vending machine it needs - or any other vending machine by prefab name, at the position the calling player is looking at. env.addtime: (Generated) Advances the in-game time of day by the specified number of hours; useful for quickly cycling to day or night for testing

global.colliders: (Generated) Prints the count of enabled versus disabled Collider components currently in the scene

global.injure: (Generated) Puts the calling player or a named target into the wounded/downed state, simulating the critical injury bleed-out state
global.objects: (Generated) Prints all live Unity Object instances sorted by total memory usage, showing type, instance count, and estimated total size in bytes
global.printallscenesinbuild: (Generated) Prints all scenes registered in the build settings with their build index and asset path
global.queue: (Generated) Prints the current state of server-side stability check and surroundings update queues; reports nothing useful on client

global.recover: (Generated) Revives the calling player or a named target from the wounded state, restoring them to standing with a small amount of health

global.subscriptions: (Generated) Prints a table of active network group subscriptions for the calling player, showing realm and group ID; supports --json flag

global.sysuid: (Generated) Prints the unique device identifier for the current machine as reported by Unity SystemInfo.deviceUniqueIdentifier

livestock.ageup: Immediately grows the nearest livestock infant into its adult stage. Optional search radius in metres (default 20).
livestock.census: Counts the livestock population and what it has produced. Optional radius in metres around the caller (default 0, the whole map).
livestock.censusreset: Zeroes the livestock census running totals and the profiler, so the next reading covers only what happens from now.
livestock.completepregnancy: Makes the nearest pregnant livestock animal give birth now, without waiting out the rest of its pregnancy. Optional search radius in metres (default 20).
livestock.cullexcess: Kills livestock past livestock.maxPerSpecies, cattle and sheep counted apart: unowned animals first, then owned ones, the worst kept and worst bred first in each. An optional head count culls down to that instead.
livestock.drawherds: Toggles drawing the free range herds within livestock.drawRadius of you, each in its own colour: the whole herd the count links through livestock.freeRangeLinkRadius, past the cap, joined by its shortest set of lines, and its size against livestock.maxFreeRangeHerd with how many of it are not owned. Pass 1 or 0 to set it instead.
livestock.drawpens: Toggles drawing every livestock pen within livestock.drawRadius of you, each in its own colour: its border, a marker on each animal on it and each trough and water container it keeps, and what it houses. Pass 1 or 0 to set it instead.
livestock.dung: Makes the nearest livestock animal drop dung now, without waiting for its timer. Optional search radius in metres (default 20).
livestock.emptyfullness: Empties the nearest livestock animal's fullness, so it goes looking for food. Optional search radius in metres (default 20).
livestock.emptyhydration: Empties the nearest livestock animal's hydration, so it goes looking for water. Optional search radius in metres (default 20).
livestock.fillfullness: Fills the nearest livestock animal's fullness, as if it had just eaten its fill. Optional search radius in metres (default 20).
livestock.fillhydration: Fills the nearest livestock animal's hydration, as if it had just drunk its fill. Optional search radius in metres (default 20).
livestock.forcebreed: Sends the nearest male livestock animal to mate with the nearest valid female, skipping the mate search. Optional search radius in metres (default 20).
livestock.makepregnant: Makes the nearest livestock animal pregnant. Obeys standard breeding rules. Optional search radius in metres (default 20).
livestock.readytomilk: Adds one stored milking to the nearest cow now, up to the most it can hold, without waiting out its cooldown. Optional search radius in metres (default 20).
livestock.readytoshear: Makes the nearest sheep ready to shear now, without waiting out its cooldown. Optional search radius in metres (default 20).
livestock.rename: Renames the nearest livestock animal. Usage: livestock.rename <name> [radius], quoting a name that contains spaces, radius in metres (default 20)
livestock.sendhome: Moves the home of every livestock animal in range to where the caller is standing, so roam and the night gather aim here until it next eats at a trough. Optional radius in metres (default 30).
livestock.setcondition: Sets the condition of the livestock animal the caller is looking at, or the nearest one. Condition is the slow average that price, dung and willingness read. Usage: livestock.setcondition <0-1> [radius], radius in metres (default 20)
livestock.setcurious: Makes the nearest livestock animal curious or not, so it will follow a player it knows without a lead. Setting it clears sleepy. Usage: livestock.setcurious <0|1> [radius], radius in metres (default 20)
livestock.setfamiliarity: Sets how many seconds of familiarity the calling player has with the livestock animal they are looking at, or the nearest one. Usage: livestock.setfamiliarity <seconds> [radius], radius in metres (default 20)
livestock.setfamiliarityall: Sets how many seconds of familiarity the calling player has with every livestock animal in range. 0 resets them all. Usage: livestock.setfamiliarityall <seconds> [radius], radius in metres (default 30)
livestock.setgene: Sets both copies of one gene on the livestock animal you are looking at, or the nearest one, the better copy being the one that shows. Usage: livestock.setgene <Dung|Yield|Fertility|Hardiness> <firstAllele> <secondAllele> [radius], each allele Bad, Ok or Good
livestock.setinbred: Makes the livestock animal you are looking at, or the nearest one, inbred or not, by forcing its two lineage markers together or apart. Usage: livestock.setinbred <0|1> [radius]
livestock.setpotential: Sets the potential of the livestock animal the caller is looking at, or the nearest one, as if it was raised that content. Usage: livestock.setpotential <0-1> [radius], radius in metres (default 20)
livestock.setsleepy: Makes the nearest livestock animal sleepy or not, so once grown it spends most of the day lying down away from the herd. Setting it clears curious. Usage: livestock.setsleepy <0|1> [radius], radius in metres (default 20)
livestock.showcoat: Prints what the nearest livestock animal's coat is made of, which is its genes and, for a species with patches, the coat seed it was born with. Usage: livestock.showcoat [radius], radius in metres (default 20)
livestock.showgenes: Prints the genes of the livestock animal you are looking at, or the nearest one, both copies of each, plus its lineage markers. Optional search radius in metres as the first argument (default 20).
livestock.showhome: Draws an arrow from the livestock animal you are looking at, or the nearest one, to its home: the last trough it ate at, or where it started. Green when that is inside a base. Optional search radius in metres (default 20) and seconds to draw for (default 10).
livestock.spawnspecial: Spawns one of the named special livestock animals in front of you, skipping the rarity roll but obeying every other rule. Usage: livestock.spawnspecial <name> [species], species being needed only for an entry that fits more than one
livestock.specials: Lists the special livestock animals this server has already produced, and counts the rest without naming them
livestock.swapgender: Swaps the gender of the nearest livestock animal. Optional search radius in metres (default 20).
manifest.printmanifest: (Generated) Prints the Facepunch application manifest in a formatted summary showing app name, version, and platform details
manifest.printmanifestraw: (Generated) Prints the raw contents of the Facepunch manifest file as an unformatted string

memsnap.native: (Generated) Takes a Unity Memory Profiler snapshot capturing native (C++) heap allocations and saves it as a timestamped .snap file in the profile/memory/ folder

navstress.idle: Stop giving destinations and reset paths
navstress.killforeign: Kill every NPC with a RustNavMeshAgent that is not a navstress dummy
navstress.rebuildstorm: Async tile rebuilds under the field: args rebuildsPerSecond (0 stops)

navstress.wander: Random destinations forever: args intervalSeconds unreachableFraction

nexus.ping: (Generated) Sends a ping to a specific Nexus server by name and prints the round-trip latency; used for testing inter-server connectivity
nexus.playeronline: (Generated) Checks whether the named or Steam-ID-specified player is currently online on any server in the Nexus cluster
nexus.refreshislands: (Generated) Forces a refresh of the Nexus island layout, re-querying the zone controller for current island assignments
nexus.transfer: (Generated) Initiates a Nexus transfer of the specified player to a named destination server or zone in the cluster
nexus.uploadmap: Reupload the map image to the nexus. Normally happens automatically at server boot. WARNING: This will lag the server!
heli.calltome: (Generated) Orders the active patrol helicopter to fly to the calling admin position and attack there
heli.death: (Generated) Forces the active patrol helicopter to die immediately, triggering its death explosion and crash sequence
heli.flee: (Generated) Orders the active patrol helicopter to immediately flee to a random distant location and disengage
heli.move: (Generated) Moves the active patrol helicopter to the calling admin current position without entering combat mode
heli.orbit: (Generated) Orders the active patrol helicopter to orbit around the calling admin current position
heli.orbitstrafe: (Generated) Orders the active patrol helicopter to orbit and strafe the calling admin position simultaneously
heli.patrol: (Generated) Orders the active patrol helicopter to resume normal patrol mode, following its randomised waypoint path across the map
heli.testpuzzle: (Generated) Triggers the helicopter puzzle sequence (approach, puzzle activation, reward) for testing the helicopter monument puzzle
physics.getbounds: (Generated) Prints the combined world-space bounding box of the entity the calling admin is looking at; useful for verifying collider extents
physics.print_colliders_per_cell: (Generated) Prints a sorted table of physics cells and how many colliders each contains; helps identify areas with excessive collider density causing physics slowdowns
physics.print_colliders_per_prefab: (Generated) Prints a sorted table of prefab names and their collider counts; identifies prefabs with unusually high collider counts for optimisation
player.createskull: (Generated) Creates a human skull item named after the given player name (or a random name if none given) and gives it to the calling player's inventory
player.createtrophy: (Generated) Creates a trophy head bag item for the specified entity type (by prefab name) and gives it to the calling player; used to generate mount-style trophy items for testing
player.dismount: (Generated) Forces the specified player (by ID) to dismount from any vehicle or mountable they are currently seated in; admin/developer/cinematic mode only
player.fillwater: <fresh/salt/rads> - Fills up liquid container items in your hotbar as well as any liquid containers you are looking at
player.gesture_radius: (Generated) Forces all players within a given radius (including the caller) to play one of the specified gesture names chosen at random; admin only; args: radius gesture1 [gesture2...]
player.gesture_radius_notme: (Generated) Same as gesture_radius but excludes the calling admin from the gesture; forces all other players within the radius to perform a random gesture from the provided list
player.gotosleep: (Generated) Forces the specified sleeping player (by ID) to enter the sleep state; admin/developer/cinematic mode only; also works on bots
player.markhostile: (Generated) Marks the calling player as hostile immediately, triggering the hostile timer as if they had attacked another player; useful for testing hostile-state dependent behaviour
player.printpresence: (Generated) Prints the calling player's current time-category presence flags: whether they are in wilderness, base, monument, swimming, boating, or flying
player.printstats: (Generated) Prints detailed life-story stats for the calling player including time alive, distances travelled, damage taken/healed, kills, and per-weapon accuracy
player.ragdollother: Ragdolls a player you're looking at
player.reloadweapons: (Generated) Fully reloads all projectile weapons, flamethrowers, and liquid weapons in every belt slot of the calling player; useful for testing without consuming ammo
player.resetmissions: Resets the saved missions progress of the given player
player.resetmissions_all: Resets the saved missions progress of all player states on this server (online and offline players). Must be entered as "resetmissions_all Y" to execute.
player.resetstate: Resets the PlayerState of the given player
player.stopgesture_radius: (Generated) Cancels any active gesture on all players within the specified radius of the calling admin; admin only; useful for stopping mass-gesture cinematics
player.swapseat: (Generated) Moves the specified player (by ID) to the given seat index on the vehicle they are mounted in; admin/developer/cinematic mode only
player.trigger_wildlife_trap: (Generated) Admin-only: triggers the trap-think logic on the wildlife trap the calling player is looking at within 5 metres, simulating a catch attempt for testing
player.unloadweapons: (Generated) Empties the ammo from all projectile weapons, flamethrowers, and liquid weapons in every belt slot of the calling player; useful for testing reload behaviour
player.wakeup: (Generated) Wakes up the specified sleeping player (by ID), ending their sleep state immediately; admin/developer/cinematic mode only
player.wakeupall: (Generated) Wakes up all sleeping players on the server at once; admin/developer/cinematic mode only; useful for clearing the sleeping player list after a wipe
pool.clear_assets: (Generated) Clears all cached entries from the asset pool matching the optional name filter
pool.clear_memory: (Generated) Clears all entries from the object memory pool matching the optional name filter; freed pooled objects are garbage collected
pool.clear_prefabs: (Generated) Clears all cached prefab instances from the prefab pool matching the optional filter, across client, server, and generic pools
pool.debug_mem_start: Start tracking objects from memory pool. Call _stop when done. Use * to explicitly request all types(super expensive!)
pool.debug_mem_stop: Stop tracking objects from memory pool & log abnormalities. Accepts max number of logs
pool.export_prefabs: (Generated) Exports the current prefab pool contents to a prefabs.csv file listing pool ID, prefab short name, and instance count
pool.fill_prefabs: (Generated) Pre-warms the prefab pool by instantiating and pooling prefabs matching the optional filter up to the given count override
pool.print_arraypool: (Generated) Prints a usage report for the BaseNetwork and ProtocolParser array pools, showing bucket sizes, capacities, and hit/miss stats
pool.print_assets: (Generated) Prints a table of all asset pool entries showing asset type, current pooled count, and pool capacity
pool.print_memory: (Generated) Prints a table of all object pool entries showing type, capacity, active count, peak usage, hit/miss counts, and spill counts; supports --json
pool.print_prefabs: (Generated) Prints a table of all prefab pool entries showing prefab name, miss count, current count, target capacity, and push/pop counts; supports --json
pool.reset_max_pool_counter: (Generated) Resets the peak-usage high-water-mark counter for all pools, allowing fresh measurement of maximum pool demand
profile.countsyncmoveentities: (Generated) Counts and prints all entities that use synchronous movement updates grouped by prefab, helping identify expensive per-frame entity movers
profile.flush_analytics: (Generated) Flushes any buffered analytics events immediately to the analytics backend rather than waiting for the next scheduled flush
profile.perfsnapshot: profile.perfsnapshot [delay=15, int] [name='Profile', str, no extension, max 32chars] [frames=10, int, max 10] [debug=false, dumps a binary snapshot as well]
profile.perfsnapshot_stream: profile.perfsnapshot_stream [name='Profile', str, no extension, max 32chars] [MainCap=32, int, max 256, buffer size for Main thread in Megabytes] [WorkerCap=8, int, max 256, buffer size for each Worker thread in Megabytes] [debug=false, dumps a binary snapshot as well]
profile.resetexportinterval: (Generated) Resets the profiler export interval timer, causing the next export to happen after a full ExportIntervalS from now
profile.start: (Generated) Starts recording a Unity Profiler binary log to a timestamped file in the profile/ folder; requires ENABLE_PROFILER build flag
profile.stop: (Generated) Stops the active Unity Profiler binary log recording and finalises the file
relay.cfg_reload: Reloads the Rust Relay configuration from disk, this will STOP the Rust Relay feature (restart with relay.restart)
relay.cfg_save: Forces a save of the Rust Relay configuration to disk
relay.clear_queue: Clears the relay send queue (useful if things are going wrong with the relay server)
relay.reconnect_reset: Clears the reconnect attempt history, resetting the reconnect budget
relay.restart: Attempts to restart the Rust Relay connection (may cause short lag)
relay.rpc_whitelist_add: Adds an RPC Message to the RPC Whitelist
relay.rpc_whitelist_rebuild: Rebuilds the RPC Whitelist ID List
relay.rpc_whitelist_remove: Removes an RPC Message from the RPC Whitelist
relay.shutdown: Shutsdown the Rust Relay sever connection
relay.status: Returns a detailed Rust Relay status report
render.print_global_entities: Print off count of global building entities on the server
render.tree_entities: Print off count of trees to ensure server sent them all
room.draw_faces: Draws the face outlines and closest-face links of the building block you are looking at and everything connected to it (breadth-first walk). Args: [duration=10] [range=40].
room.draw_networkgroups: Draws room contents and boundary network groups for the building you are looking at. Green = subscribed, yellow = held but awaiting subscription, red = not held, grey = positional grid. Args: [duration=10] [range=40].
room.draw_portals: Draws the portals of the building you are looking at (green = open, red = closed)
room.draw_rooms: Draws the faces of the building you are looking at coloured by room. Args: [duration=10] [range=40]. Outside room is dim white; arrows point into the room each face borders.
room.draw_visible: Draws the faces of every room you can see into from where you stand (green), and the rooms you cannot (red)
room.exportbase: Editor-only: exports the current room partition to RoomFixtures/<name>.json so it can be replayed offline in the edit-mode tests. Pass a name; defaults to 'capture'. To capture a base from a live server, copypaste it into an editor server first.
room.exportpastes: Editor-only: pastes every .data file in a directory one at a time and exports each to RoomFixtures/<folder>/<paste>.json for the edit-mode fixture tests. Args: <directory> [folder=directory name]. Pastes that already have a fixture are skipped.
room.occlusionstats: Prints interior occlusion's shadow-mode report: how much of the world ended up effectively outside (fail open) and how much each player has hidden
room.printfaces: Prints the closest-face link of every edge on the building block you are looking at. Pass --ddraw to also draw the links.
room.printhidden: Prints which interior rooms a player can currently see into, i.e. which room network groups they hold. Defaults to yourself.
room.printportals: Prints every portal of the building you are looking at (rooms joined, filler, open state)
room.printrooms: Prints the room partition of the building you are looking at
room.printvisible: Prints the room a player is standing in and every room they can see into. Defaults to yourself.
rustnav.bakestats: Print accumulated navmesh bake statistics. Pass true to reset them instead
rustnav.dumptilegeo: Rebuild one default-navmesh tile synchronously and dump its assembled geometry + heightfield bounds to a file for the offline native-build harness: rustnav.dumptilegeo <tx> <ty> <path>
rustnav.navmeshstats: List every navmesh (default + independent monuments/islands/ghostships) ranked by accumulated worker build time
satellite.launch: Dev: search for a safe crash site around the calling player using the exact same acceptance checks a control computer's lock-in uses (topology, water, unevenness, safezones, obstructions), then launch the full orbital descent there. Not a full session replica: searches around the player rather than a computer's semi-random targeting center, always does a fresh scan (no thruster-history reuse), and has no owning computer (no countdown screen, radius floor still enforced, no-build volume self-despawns after impact instead of being computer-managed): satellite.launch [radius]
satellite.launchquick: Dev: exactly satellite.launch — same crash-site search and validation — but skips the wait: the satellite spawns already in phase 2, 30 seconds from impact, at the point of the descent path it would normally reach then: satellite.launchquick [radius]
satellite.random: Trigger a satellite crash at a random valid position on the map
satellite.trigger: Trigger a satellite crash at the calling player's position or optional coordinates, with an optional satellite mass (kg) driving loot like a computer-controlled crash: satellite.trigger [mass] or satellite.trigger [x z [mass]]
server.botcount: (Generated) Returns the current number of bot (AI-controlled player) entities active on the server
server.broadcastplayvideo: (Generated) Sends a video URL to all connected players, causing the in-game video player to open and play the specified video on every client
server.clear_bushes_radius: (Generated) Kills all server-side bush entities within a given radius of the calling player (or a specified world position); args: radius [x y z]
server.clear_loot_spawn_cache: Clears the loot spawn cache used to restrict loot into each era
server.clear_trees_radius: (Generated) Kills all server-side tree entities within a given radius of the calling player (or a specified world position); args: radius [x y z]
server.combatlog_outgoing: Get the player combat log, only showing outgoing damage
server.corpseinfo: Get info on player corpses on the server
server.enforce_era_restrictions: Deletes items on the server that are not allowed in the era
server.fillchickencoop: (Generated) Debug command: fills all chicken coops within 5 metres of the calling player to their maximum capacity
server.fps: (Generated) Prints the current server frame rate in frames per second
server.listplayerreportcounts: List the amount of reports players on the server have received
server.listtoolcupboards: Prints all the Tool Cupboards on the server
server.listvendingmachines: Prints all the vending machines on the server
server.netprotocol: (Generated) Returns the network protocol identifier string the server is currently using; clients must match this to connect
server.packetlog: (Generated) Prints a sorted table of network packet types and their cumulative call counts since logging was enabled; requires packetlog_enabled = true
server.player_state_cache_count: (Generated) Prints the number of player states currently held in the in-memory player state cache
server.player_state_cache_evictions: (Generated) Prints the total number of player state cache entries evicted since server startup; high values suggest the cache size should be increased
server.playerlistpos: Prints the position of all players on the server
server.printposcenter: Print the current player center position.
server.printreadqueue: (Generated) Prints the current server incoming network read queue depth (packet count and total byte size)
server.printwipeid: Prints the current wipe id of the sav
server.printwritequeue: (Generated) Prints the current server outgoing network write queue depth (packet count and total byte size)
server.readcfg: (Generated) Reads and executes serverauto.cfg then server.cfg from the server's cfg folder, applying all saved convar values
server.resetserveremoji: Rescans the serveremoji folder, note that clients will need to reconnect to get the latest emoji
server.rpclog: (Generated) Prints a sorted table of RPC identifiers, their string names, and cumulative call counts; requires rpclog_enabled = true
server.sendnetworkupdate: Send network update for all players
server.setshowholstereditems: Show holstered items on player bodies
server.snapshot: This sends a snapshot of all the entities in the client's pvs. This is mostly redundant, but we request this when the client starts recording a demo.. so they get all the information.
softcore.raidwindow_status: (Generated) Print the current raid-window state: server local time, effective hours, and whether the window is open right now
spawn.cargoshipdockingtest: (Generated) Spawns a cargo ship and initiates the harbor docking test sequence at the specified docking path index; used to test cargo ship docking behaviour at harbors
spawn.cargoshipevent: (Generated) Spawns a cargo ship and starts the cargo ship event immediately, bypassing the normal random event scheduler
spawn.ch47event: (Generated) Triggers a CH47 Chinook scientist event targeting the calling player position; optionally pass a start distance in metres (default 300)
spawn.delete_all_populations: (Generated) Deletes all entities from every active population spawner on the server at once; effectively despawns all wildlife, NPCs, and resource nodes
spawn.delete_populations: (Generated) Deletes all spawned entities belonging to the named population(s); pass one or more population names as arguments to target specific groups
spawn.dump_map: (Generated) Generates a debug spawn map for a named population, simulating up to the given number of spawn attempts and reporting how many would succeed; used to diagnose spawn point coverage
spawn.fill_groups: Fills all spawn groups to their maximum count without waiting for the normal tick interval
spawn.fill_individuals: (Generated) Immediately respawns all individually tracked entities that are currently missing, bypassing the normal tick_individuals delay
spawn.fill_populations: (Generated) Immediately fills all population spawners to their target density; useful after a wipe or server restart to skip the gradual ramp-up period
spawn.ore_map: Renders a PNG of every spawned ore nodes location to <rootFolder>/debug/ore-nodes.png (blue rings = safezones)
spawn.report: (Generated) Prints a spawn handler report listing all populations, their current count, target count, and fill percentage; pass true for detailed mode or a name filter as a second argument
spawn.reset_groups: Clears all spawn groups of already spawned entities, then re-fills them
spawn.respawnloot_all: Respawns loot in all loot containers currently on the server
spawn.respawnloot_lookingat: Respawns loot in the loot container currently being looked at
spawn.respawnloot_radius: Respawns loot in all loot containers within the given radius
spawn.scalars: (Generated) Prints a table of current spawn scalar values including player fraction, excess, population rate, density, and group rate; pass --json for machine-readable output
spawn.simulate_loot: <iterations> - Simulates a number of iterations on the closest loot container and sums up the items spawned
spawn.svshielddummy: (Generated) Server-side handler that spawns a dummy player entity at the given position and direction loaded with the Shields loadout, optionally holstering the shield; triggered by spawn.shielddummy
stability.refresh_stability: (Generated) Forces an immediate recalculation of stability for all building blocks in the world; expensive on large bases
supply.drop: (Generated) Spawns a supply drop at the calling admin or player position; the drop falls from the sky with a parachute like a naturally occurring airdrop
system.cpu_affinity: (Generated) Sets the CPU core affinity mask for the process using comma-separated core indices or dash-separated ranges (e.g. 0,2-5)
system.cpu_priority: (Generated) Sets the OS process priority class (belownormal, normal, abovenormal, high); Idle and Realtime are blocked; not supported on OSX

territory.factions: List created factions and their colours

territory.setcell: Set a hex cell by index: territory.setcell <cell> <faction name|none>
territory.sethere: Set the hex cell at your position: territory.sethere <faction name|none>
territory.state: Returns a JSON report of the territory grid: dimensions, offsets and a per-faction breakdown (cells held, share of claimed land, region counts) sorted by holdings
vehicle.autohover: (Generated) Toggles auto-hover mode on the mini-helicopter the calling player is piloting, maintaining altitude automatically without pilot input
vehicle.boatdriftinfo: Print out boat drift status for all boats
vehicle.fixcars: Fixes up vehicles within 10m of the player by repairing to full hp, adding fuel to engines, and more
vehicle.killboats: (Generated) Destroys all boat vehicles (rowboats, RHIBs) currently spawned on the server
vehicle.killcars: (Generated) Destroys all modular car vehicles currently spawned on the server
vehicle.killdrones: (Generated) Destroys all drone vehicles currently spawned on the server
vehicle.killminis: (Generated) Destroys all minicopter vehicles currently spawned on the server
vehicle.killmotorbikes: (Generated) Destroys all motorbike vehicles currently spawned on the server
vehicle.killpushbikes: (Generated) Destroys all push bike vehicles currently spawned on the server
vehicle.killscraphelis: (Generated) Destroys all scrap transport helicopter vehicles currently spawned on the server
vehicle.killtrains: (Generated) Destroys all train vehicles currently spawned on the server
vehicle.setrepairablepads: Forces every repairable vehicle pad on the map to be rebuilt, or pass false to wreck them again.

vehicle.train_speed_all: Set all trains to the same target speed in km/h. Usage: vehicle.train_speed_all <km/h>. Negative = reverse.
vehicle.train_stop: Gradually brake a train to a stop. Usage: vehicle.train_stop (look-at) or vehicle.train_stop <id>.
voice.togglevoicerangeboost: Enabled/disables voice range boost for a player eg. ToggleVoiceRangeBoost sam 1
weather.list_cloud_configs: (Generated) Lists all available volumetric cloud configuration asset names registered in the Climate instance

workshop.print_approved_skins: (Generated) Prints a list of all workshop-approved skins on the server with their item short names and approved skin IDs

handcuffs.togglecuffslocked: (Generated) Toggles the locked state of the handcuffs held by the calling admin player, switching between locked and unlocked
ioentity.debugqueue: (Generated) Prints the current state of all IO entity processing queues showing queue type and pending entity counts; admin-only

networkprofiler.serverprofile: networkprofiler.serverprofile [time to profile(in seconds), min(0.1), max(1000), float]
npcvendingmachine.addhours: Simulates the provided number of hours passing in the vending machine system
npcvendingmachine.printallpricechanges: Print out all current price changes on the server
npcvendingmachine.resetdynamicpricing: Resets the state of all discounts and surcharges from NPC vending machines
playerboat.kill_all_above_block_count: (Generated) Kills all player boats that have more building blocks than the given threshold; used for server cleanup
playerboat.kill_all_above_deployable_cou: (Generated) Kills all player boats that have more deployed entities than the given threshold; used for server cleanup
playerboat.kill_io_deployables: Kills any IO entities deployed on boats. Not a fast command. Use sparingly when needed.
playerboat.kill_nonconvex_deployables: Kills any entities deployed on boats with non-convex colliders. Not a fast command. Use sparingly when needed.
playerboat.lookatdragbyangle: (Generated) Prints drag force debug data based on the angle between the boat heading and player look direction; admin-only
playerboat.print_nonconvex: Prints a list of boats with non-convex collider deployables. Not a fast command. Use sparingly when needed.
playerboat.print_stats: (Generated) Prints statistics about all player boats on the server including block counts, deployable counts, and resource totals
playerboat.setsailsopen: (Generated) Opens all sails on the player boat directly in front of the calling admin player; admin-only dev command
playerboat.sink: (Generated) Instantly kills the player boat directly in front of the calling admin player; admin-only dev command
relationshipmanager.addtoteam: (Generated) Adds the calling player to their existing team, creating the team entry if needed
relationshipmanager.createandaddtoteam: (Generated) Creates a new team with the calling player and adds the specified player (by UID) to it; returns status string
relationshipmanager.fakeinvite: (Generated) Sends a fake team invite from the given team ID to the calling player; used for testing team invite UI flow
relationshipmanager.forceaddtoteam: Adds a player to a team whether they are on the server or not
relationshipmanager.sleeptoggle: (Generated) Toggles the sleep/wake state of the entity the calling admin player is looking at (within 5m); admin-only
relationshipmanager.trycreateteam: (Generated) Creates a new team with the calling player as leader; fails if teams are disabled (maxTeamSize == 0)
relationshipmanager.wipe_all_contacts: (Generated) Wipes all relationship contacts data for every player on the server; admin-only
relationshipmanager.wipecontacts: (Generated) Wipes all relationship contacts data for the calling player
rentableshop.closenearestshop: Close the nearest shop in 10m. Useful for testing
rentableshop.randomiseownerofnearestshop: Randomise the owner of the nearest shop in 10m. Useful for testing
rentableshop.resettakeoverprotectionofcl: Reset the takeover protection duration of nearest shop. Useful for testing
ridablehorse.ragdoll: (Generated) Ragdolls the ridable horse entity directly in front of the calling admin player; useful for testing horse physics and death states
ridablehorse.setforsale: (Generated) Marks the horse directly in front of the calling admin player as for-sale, enabling the purchase interaction
ridablehorse.sethorsebreed: (Generated) Sets the breed index of the horse directly in front of the calling admin player to the given integer value
seagullgroup.land: Lands every flying seagull group within the given radius (default 300) of where you are looking, each on its nearest free land point.
seagullgroup.landat: Lands the flying seagull group nearest where you are looking, within the given radius (default 300), on the free land point nearest it.
seagullgroup.startle: Startles every landed seagull group within the given radius (default 100) of where you are looking.
log.level: (Generated) Sets the log verbosity level for a specific named RustLog channel; takes a channel name and optional level integer
serverocclusion.occlusionvalidategroups: (Generated) Validates that all server occlusion network groups are correctly mapped to their occlusion data; reports any inconsistencies found
serverocclusion.serverocclusiondebug: Tests occlusion visibility between two positions
sleepingbag.assigntoplayer: (Generated) Reassigns ownership of a sleeping bag (by entity ID) to the calling player; notifies both the old and new owner
sleepingbag.clearfromplayer: (Generated) Clears ownership of a sleeping bag (by entity ID), setting the owner ID to 0 and removing it from the old owner's bag list
telephonemanager.printallphones: (Generated) Prints a table of all registered telephone entities showing their number, directory name, and world position
travellingvendor.spawn: (Generated) Spawns a Travelling Vendor at the calling player's position on the nearest ring road; registered as travellingvendor.spawn
travellingvendor.startevent: (Generated) Spawns a Travelling Vendor event instance; registered as travellingvendor.startevent
triggerbase.clearexcludelayers: (Generated) Removes the exclude layer configuration from all registered TriggerBase instances, resetting them to detect all layers
triggerbase.setexcludelayers: (Generated) Applies the configured exclude layer mask to all registered TriggerBase instances to filter out unwanted layer detections
vddraw.setisrecording: (Generated) Toggles or explicitly sets VDDraw recording state; when enabled starts capturing DDraw commands for replay; when disabled stops recording
vendingmachine.clearallvendingcustomerhi: Wipe the backend customer stats data on all vending machines. Slow operation.
vendingmachine.clearallvendinghistory: Wipe the backend stats data on all vending machines. Slow operation.
watertreatmentflowratebroadcast.force_fl: Force the water treatment flow rate per minute. Pass no argument to release the override and return to pressure-derived state.
wipetimer.printtimezones: (Generated) Prints a JSON list of all system, Windows, and IANA timezone identifiers available on the server machine
wipetimer.printwipe: (Generated) Prints the current wipe timer status including next wipe date, frequency, and time remaining
kits.creator: Executes kits.creator
